abstract.para: Select a storage device for the installation in the Storage screen.

topic.para: Currently installations on single discs or LVM are supported. To change the disk or use LVM, click the device name More devicesMore options button in the Installation devices section.

To use DASD, &iscsi; or zFCP devices, you need to configure them first. Click Other options and select the desired technology. The DASD and zFCP options are only available if the corresponding devices are attached.
To activate a DASD disk, select it from the list and click Perform an actionActivate. Once the disk is activated, you can select it for installation in the previous screen.

To activate a zFCP disk, select it from the list and activate it by clicking on the three-dot menu.
If the activation status is not displayed correctly, press F5 to refresh the installer interface.
To detect an &iscsi; disk, select the &iscsi; initiator and click Discover &iscsi; targets.

By default, the file systems are allocated as new partitions on the selected device. You can change this behavior in the drop-down list labeled All content will be deleted in the Installation devices section. The following space policies are available:

listitem.para: All partitions are removed, and any data on the disks is lost.
The data is kept, but &agama; shrinks the current partitions as needed.
The data is kept. Only the space not assigned to any partition is used.
Select what to do with each partition.

topic.para: To edit individual partitions, expand the Partitions and file systems section by clicking >. Optionally, you can configure Btrfs snapshots, boot options and enable full disk encryption (FDE).
